question_set.question: Use trace_node with node_name equal to Default Y3 to rank treatments by overall utilization efficiency in order to know how do treatments rank by overall utilization efficiency?

answer.value: Junk Orig shows the highest default risk with a 27.3% default rate (30 out of 110 loans), significantly higher than other rating categories. BBB Orig has a moderate default rate of 4.5% (10 out of 220 loans), while AAA, AA, and A Orig have 0% default rates.

key_insights: Junk Orig has the highest default rate at 27.3%
BBB Orig has moderate default risk at 4.5%

reasoning_trace.rationale: Trace the flow to Default Y3 to analyze which original rating categories contribute most to defaults
